spans.s:
वावदूक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Talking much, gabbling, prattling.
 E. वद् to
speak, Unādi aff. ऊक, the root reiterated.
वावय m. (-यः) A sort of Basil, (Ocymum sanctum.)

वावहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Who or what bears or carries much.
 E. वह् to bear, कि aff.

वावृत्(उ)वावृतु r. 4th cl. (वावृत्यते)
 1. To choose or select.
 2. To serve.

वावृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Chosen, appointed.
 E. वृत् to be, aff. क्त, and the
root reiterated.

वावृत्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Choosing, preferring.
 E. वावृत to choose, शानच् aff.
